Online political livestream controversy draws criticism from civil advocacy organizations over controversial guest statements.
Evidence: Broadcast recording, organization press releases
#OnlineMedia #Politics

Streaming hosts claimed the broadcast provided valuable alternative election coverage for young voters.
Stated Judgement: (+0.50, +0.00) — Lesser Good

Online streaming panels often rely on inflammatory rhetoric to drive view metrics, drawing legitimate criticism from watchdog organizations.
Resulting Judgement: (-1.00, -1.00) — Greater Evil

Verdict: FAIL — Awakening into Destruction.
Online political streaming prioritizing sensationalized rhetoric over balanced public civic discourse.

- Stream Hosts: FAIL (-0.3, -0.2) - Amplifying polarising rhetoric for audience engagement.
- Watchdog Organizations: PASS (+0.4, +0.3) - Monitoring and critiquing public speech standards.
The DSA hosted Hasan Piker for an election night stream, leading to criticism from the ADL regarding Piker's past rhetoric. This follows several electoral victories for DSA-endorsed candidates.

The Poison:
The article conflates political outreach with ideological endorsement to manufacture a controversy, distracting from the actual policy outcomes of the election.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
The Plane Error is Q1 (Who): The article treats the DSA as a monolith responsible for a streamer's every word, ignoring the actual political candidates who won.

Social Physics Analysis:
The article is a Smart Selfish Maneuver. It takes the DSA's electoral success (a threat to the status quo) and manufactures a crisis (antisemitism) to distract from the political reality and project blame onto the organization.

The Trajectory: The Path of Awakening into Destruction.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Evil. The article claims to defend Jewish safety but attacks political opponents.

The Unavoidable Truth: Political organizations often use popular media figures for outreach.
The Unavoidable Lie: Hosting a streamer constitutes an endorsement of all their past statements.

Alethekanon:
The article confuses platforming with endorsement, a common tactic to silence political dissent. It prioritizes a smear campaign over actual discourse.

Awwthekanon:
It is painful to see political discourse reduced to guilt-by-association. We should focus on the candidates' policies rather than the streamers they associate with.

Brothekanon:
It's just a streamer, man. Fox is trying to make a big deal out of nothing because the DSA actually won some seats.

Spirithekanon:
"Judge not, that you be not judged." (Matthew 7:1) — FAIL
The article judges the DSA by the words of another, failing to see the beam in its own eye.

Stated Claim / Post Context:
DSA accused of ‘elevating’ antisemitic, pro-terror rhetoric after Hasan Piker hosts election stream

ADL CEO Jonathan Greenblatt accused the DSA of elevating antisemitism by choosing Hasan Piker to host its official election night livestream.

Actual Article Body:

Far-left pundit Hasan Piker streamed live on Twitch for more than 13 hours on Election Day. (Twitch/Screenshot)

The Democratic Socialists of America (DSA) chose controversial Twitch streamer Hasan Piker to host its official election night livestream, drawing a blunt response from Anti-Defamation League (ADL) CEO Jonathan Greenblatt, who accused the group of elevating rhetoric supportive of terrorism and antisemitism.

"Of all the people the DSA could have chosen to host its official election night livestream, it chose Hasan Piker, someone who proudly expresses support for terrorist organizations and traffics in antisemitism," Greenblatt wrote in a post on X.

"Let that sink in. The DSA isn't distancing itself from this kind of rhetoric. It's elevating it."

The DSA saw several of its endorsed or supported candidates win on Tuesday night, including Chris Rabb in Pennsylvania, Melat Kiros in Colorado, Donavan McKinney in Michigan, Claire Valdez in New York and Darializa Avila Chevalier in New York.

HASAN PIKER DECLARES 'WOKE IS BACK,' FANTASIZES ABOUT PUTTING DONALD TRUMP IN PRISON

Twitch streamer Hasan Piker hosted the Democratic Socialists of America election night livestream. (Florencia Tan Jun/Web Summit via Sportsfile via Getty Images)

In his post, Greenblatt included a link to an ADL article with statements by Piker that the organization criticized, including comments the ADL said have "alluded to classic antisemitic tropes and conspiracy theories."

The article contains some of Piker's more infamous remarks, such as when he referred to Orthodox Jews as "inbred" and his classification of Zionism as "an exterminationist ideology built around ethnoreligious supremacist values."

Piker did not hold back in his response to Greenblatt, writing, "Suck it Jonathan, your best friend Elon burned 450 million to lose races all over the country tonight you bald piece of s---!!!"

The ADL did not immediately respond to Piker’s remarks about Greenblatt.

On Tuesday, Piker described the election as a "blue-clear apocalypse" after Democrats won major gains in the House and Senate. Pike livestreamed for more than 13 hours, offering his signature political commentary as votes were tallied.

"Trumpism is dying, and I could not feel any better," Piker told his audience. "Just imagine a world where Donald Trump is in f---ing prison."

He also gloated over Republicans' defeat, saying, "This is perhaps the worst possible scenario for the Republican Party. I think their odious agenda, their corruption, the destabilizing impact that they’ve had, the endless warfare and its consequences on the American economy, are finally coming back to bite them."

RADICAL SOCIALIST WING'S HUGE NIGHT REVEALS ASCENDING CLOUT WITHIN DEMOCRATIC PARTY

Ahead of the midterm elections, Piker drew attention in political circles as he interviewed and even campaigned with DSA-backed and DSA-aligned candidates. Piker came to national prominence after he campaigned with Senator-elect Abdul El-Sayed in Michigan.

While his race was not explicitly DSA-backed, the organization said El-Sayed "supports DSA priorities like Medicare-for-all."

El-Sayed's decision to appear with Piker drew criticism. The candidate appeared to distance himself from the streamer, holding no additional campaign events with him toward the end of the election cycle. This came after critics accused Piker of suggesting that Jewish Americans' support for Israel could lead to antisemitic violence against them.

DEMOCRATS CONDEMNING HASAN PIKER AS BACKLASH SPREADS THROUGH PARTY

Controversial Twitch streamer Hasan Piker gloated over Republicans' losses in the midterm elections. (Sam Barnes/Web Summit via Sportsfile via Getty Images)

"People don't f--- with Israel any longer. And if Jews in America keep putting this idea out there that they're singularly invested in Israel, eventually someone will come around and take action not against Israel, mind you, but against American Jews," Piker said during a Twitch stream in August.

While El-Sayed did not outright condemn the comments, he responded to Piker, saying, "I believe all Americans deserve the right to advocate for what they believe without fear of violence. This is particularly true for communities that have been intimidated for their beliefs in the past.

"My commitment to Jewish safety is the same as my commitment to the safety of my own daughters. Antisemitism is a scourge, and we need to address it in all its forms. And I stand against any rhetoric that puts the community at risk."

CLICK HERE TO DOWNLOAD THE FOX NEWS APP

Fox News Digital reached out to the DSA for comment but did not immediately receive a response.

Stated Claim / Post Context:
Accused Oakland perv arrested for secretly filming women as cops expose his sick recording device

Police are now scrambling to identify anyone else who may have been targeted.

Actual Article Body:
Switch between CA and NY editions here.

See more of our coverage in your search results.

A suspected pervert allegedly used cameras hidden in his shoes to secretly film women and minors in Northern California, including at a popular Berkeley eatery, police said.

Noah Stein, 35, of Oakland, was arrested Oct. 30 after investigators allegedly uncovered a scheme involving concealed shoe cameras and a second hidden recording device at a restaurant near UC Berkeley, according to the Berkeley Police Department.

The investigation started on October 26, when a teenage girl told police a man may have been recording videos up her skirt while she was waiting in line at Lox Stock and Bagel restaurant, located at 2043 Allston Way, near downtown Berkeley.

The biggest news, opinion and culture shaping California right now.

Please provide a valid email.

By clicking above you agree to the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.

Never miss a story

The teen told police she accidentally stepped on the man’s foot and then noticed a camera pointed toward her.

“Following the report, detectives collected evidence from the scene and identified a possible suspect,” Berkeley police said.

Investigators used Automated License Plate Reader technology to help place Stein in the area when the alleged incident occurred.

But cops got a “significant break in the investigation” early Friday morning, Oct. 30, when an officer patrolling the south side of the college campus was approached by someone who reported “seeing a man with a camera attached to his shoe, apparently recording up women’s skirts.”

California Post News: Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, X, YouTube, WhatsApp, LinkedInCalifornia Post Sports Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, XCalifornia Post  Opinion California Post Newsletters: Sign up here!California Post App: Download here!Home delivery: Sign up here!Page Six Hollywood: Sign up here!

The suspect was located and detained, cops said.

“During a search of the surrounding area, officers also recovered a mini camera that had been discarded in a nearby trash can,” police said.

Stein is facing numerous charges including invasion of privacy using a concealed video recording device, annoying or molesting a minor and destruction of evidence, according to police.

“As the investigation continued, detectives obtained a search warrant for the suspect’s residence in Oakland and seized several electronic devices.”

Cops also discovered a stationary camera allegedly concealed inside the Taco Bell Cantina near campus on Oct. 29.

Investigators believe Stein may have been frequenting the UC Berkeley South Campus area “for several weeks and may have secretly recorded additional victims.”

Police are now scrambling to identify anyone else who may have been targeted.

“We are urging anyone who was inside the Taco Bell Cantina after 11 pm that night, believes they may have been secretly recorded, or has information about this suspect to contact the Berkeley Police Department’s Sex Crimes Unit at 510-981-5735,” authorities said.

The California Post reached out to the Berkeley campus for further comment.
